verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents edge functions written in Python, Go, or Rust. The Container Runtime lets Vercel Functions run any code from an OCI image, but those are regional server functions (default region iad1), not edge functions, so they are an adjacent feature rather than this capability. The only language mention is a community complaint about getting just "JS/TS/Go, or WebAssembly gimmicks," which is not product documentation and does not mention edge execution.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write edge functions in languages other than JavaScript such as Python, Go, or Rust
